items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then, From the Hot Afternoon, with Paul Desmond

ctx.x: Yeah, A&M. Then, From the Hot Afternoon, with Paul Desmond, another major – I don’t know if this was memorable, but another – a major project, because of the amount of personnel, full orchestra, or chamber orchestra, I should say. I should just say, a string section.
I’d have to hear it again.
